messages:
erin: Noticed an uptick in Pending + attach timeouts for GPUs in ap-southeast1 rack-B. Multiple gang-scheduled jobs fail when pods hit volume attach timeouts and then OOM during startup.
sam: Specific error traces?
erin: From a failing pod: `AttachVolume.Attach failed for volume "gpu-kv-cache" : rpc error: code = DeadlineExceeded desc = context deadline exceeded` and then `OOMKilled` in the container logs during init.
leo: Any recent changes to PCIe/NVSwitch firmware or kernel? Could be a regression causing link resets.
erin: No scheduled maintenance but oncall-bot flagged a throughput dip.
oncall-bot: ALERT[3260012200] nvlink_throughput_drop rack-b: 55% drop vs baseline for 8m on node-b-17,node-b-18,node-b-22
sam: Can we get `dmesg | tail -n 200` and `journalctl -u nvidia-kernel` from node-b-17? Also run `lspci -vvv` to see AER counters.
erin: Pasted snippets: repeated `pcie link retrain` followed by `AER: Uncorrected (Non-Fatal) error` referencing `0000:3b:00.0` and `nvlink: link error: retrain`.
leo: That points to either a flaky PCIe lane on the host board or a failing NVSwitch port. I'll pull BMC logs and check vendor bug tracker for similar AER signatures.
ops-jen: Immediate mitigations: cordon and drain the three affected nodes, failover critical Dedicated jobs to other racks, and mark nodes as `gpu:unstable` in inventory to avoid new scheduling. Use: `kubectl cordon node-b-17 && kubectl drain node-b-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`
erin: Started drains for node-b-17 and node-b-18. Capturing all relevant logs to /var/tmp/nvlink-incident-node-b-17.tar.gz and uploading to INC-3261.
sam: After drain, let's run a controlled 30m stress test (memory+nvlink ping) on a warm spare node to validate link stability before we rejoin any node. We'll use the `nvlink-test` harness at commit a1b2c3.
leo: If vendor firmware mismatch is confirmed (we saw a beta roll last month on some racks), we should escalate immediately. Also consider moving these three nodes out of Dedicated pool until vendor provides guidance. That has cost implications; Erin, can you estimate extra GPU-hours and potential overage?
erin: Quick calc: the failed retries and extended job runtime added ~0.8 GPU-hours per job on avg for 15 affected jobs in last 6h -> ~12 GPU-hours. At current pricing that's roughly $180 extra in the last 6h. If this persists, monthly delta could be material.
ops-jen: I'll coordinate with sales/finance if we need to reshuffle commitments. For now, cordoned nodes will stay out of autoscaler pools.
oncall-bot: Incident created INC-3261, priority P2.
erin: Note: observed `nvlink_peer_memory: peer mem attach timeout` in some kernel logs when k8s attempted to map device memory during pod init. That aligns with pods hitting attach deadlines.
sam: Good catch. That confirms we should focus on link-layer stability. Leo, share BMC + switch FPS with vendor.
leo: Uploading BMC logs and nvlink counters. Opening vendor ticket with AER traces and nvlink throughput heatmaps.
erin: Drain completed for node-b-17. Moving running jobs to rack-C. Will continue collecting logs and follow vendor guidance.
sam: Post-mortem actions: add a scheduler rule to avoid scattered gang pods across racks with heterogeneous NVSwitch firmware until inventory is homogenized, add AER-based node health telemetry to trigger preemptive cordons, and run a quarterly firmware audit.
erin: Agree. Adding these to the incident checklist. Will update once vendor responds. :white_check_mark:
